lines.x: Financial markets are pricing in three to four Riksbank rate hikes next year, exceeding economist forecasts.
Nordic Compass and Nasdaq proposed an integrated stock exchange market to attract billions in capital, though institutional pension funds expressed hesitation.
Harald Mix-backed battery maker Polarium filed for bankruptcy, citing plummeting battery market prices and intense competition from Chinese producers.
Industry body Swedish Fintech cautioned that an EU proposal for a €5.2 billion digital tax on tech giants could ignite new international trade tariffs.
